summary: The RTL layout is mostly functional, but there is an icon placement inconsistency in the glass chip actions.

issues.title: Inconsistent icon alignment in RTL
issues.description: Icon placement is mismatched across sibling chips, appearing on the left for two items and on the right for the destructive item.
issues.evidence: The link and download icons appear to the left of their labels, while the trash icon is placed to the right of 'מחיקה'.
issues.suggestion: Standardize icon positioning across all chips to consistently lead or trail the text in RTL.
